name: Grimtotem Compound
summary: In central Feralas, the Grimtotem keep two encampments east of Dire Maul. Their compound is a base for mysterious, destructive operations in the region.

sections.title: A Bastion of the Black Tribe
sections.body:
East of Dire Maul, two Grimtotem encampments give the clan a foothold in Feralas. Unlike the tauren who follow Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff, they act alone and meet outsiders with hostility.

In the southern half, captive native sprite darters are held in a large wooden cage for reasons of their own. Rogue gnolls stalk the northern perimeter.

faq.q: Who lives in the Grimtotem Compound?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem clan lives in the compound. These secretive, aggressive tauren act apart from the Horde-allied tribes in Mulgore and are known for their hostility to outsiders and ruthless methods.

faq.q: Why are sprite darters caged in the compound?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem have captured native sprite darters and locked them in a large cage in the southern village. Why they hold the creatures is not known.

faq.q: Where is the Grimtotem Compound located?
faq.answer: The compound lies in central Feralas, just east of the ancient Highborne ruins of Dire Maul. Wild gnoll packs camp nearby to the northeast.

angles.text: As a tauren, you may know the Grimtotem pay nominal homage to Cairne Bloodhoof. Their compound shows their untamed ambition, far from Thunder Bluff's watchful eyes.
As an Alliance member, you face Grimtotem who are relentlessly hostile to the Night Elves and their allies.
